description: Defines classes and interfaces for overlay widgets management in ANGLE, including Overlay, OverlayState, and DummyOverlay classes, with methods for widget access, initialization, and rendering hooks.

classes.name: OverlayState
classes.description: Manages overlay widget states, buffers, and font data initialization.

classes.name: Overlay
classes.description: Main class for overlay widget management, including widget retrieval, initialization, and rendering hooks.

classes.name: DummyOverlay
classes.description: Stub implementation of overlay interface used when overlay is disabled.

methods.name: getWidgetCoordinatesBufferSize
methods.description: Returns size of widget coordinates buffer.

methods.name: getTextWidgetsBufferSize
methods.description: Returns size of text widgets buffer.

methods.name: getGraphWidgetsBufferSize
methods.description: Returns size of graph widgets buffer.

methods.name: fillEnabledWidgetCoordinates
methods.description: Fills buffer with enabled widget coordinates.

methods.name: getTextWidget
methods.description: Retrieves a text widget by ID.

methods.name: getCountWidget
methods.description: Retrieves a count widget by ID.

methods.name: getPerSecondWidget
methods.description: Retrieves a per-second widget by ID.

methods.name: getRunningGraphWidget
methods.description: Retrieves a running graph widget by ID.

methods.name: getRunningHistogramWidget
methods.description: Retrieves a running histogram widget by ID.

methods.name: getWidgetAs
methods.description: Template method to cast widget to specific type.

methods.name: enableOverlayWidgetsFromEnvironment
methods.description: Enables overlay widgets based on environment variables.
